```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse=TRUE,comment="#>",warning=FALSE,message=FALSE)
```

`vstar` provides pointer-backed `ImageData`, `PolyData`, and `Plotter` classes.

```{r}
library(vstar)
n<-20L;a<-seq(-1,1,length.out=n);g<-expand.grid(x=a,y=a,z=a)
v<-array(with(g,exp(-4*(x^2+y^2+z^2))),c(n,n,n))
volume<-imageData(v,spacing=c(.1,.1,.1),origin=c(-1,-1,-1))
volume$dimensions();volume$scalar_range()
surface<-volume$contour(.5);slice<-volume$slice_z(10)
surface$n_points();slice$has_scalars()
```

Native rendering is not executed during package checks:

```{r eval=FALSE}
p<-Plotter$new();p$add_mesh(slice,scalars=TRUE,show_scalar_bar=TRUE)
p$add_volume(volume,colormap="magma");p$reset_camera();p$show();p$close()
```
